about: Which crate compiles each file of the app tree (app/src). The files never move: a view crate is a generated lib.rs that names its files in app/src and re-exports the crates below at the same module paths, so crate::modules::... is one path in every crate. 'files' wins over 'rules', a test file follows the file it tests, the first matching rule wins ('*' is one path segment), then the top crate. 'deps' are the crates directly below. gen-mod-tree.py writes each crates/<name>/Cargo.toml and src/lib.rs and the marked block of the top manifest.
